response.reason: The kernel does a sound fp32 log1p: exact split u=1+x with a first-order rounding correction (x-(u-1))/u, range reduction of the mantissa to [0.75,1.5), an odd atanh series (2z(1+z²/3+z⁴/5+z⁶/7)) whose truncation and coefficient errors are ~1e-8 on this range, and a two-part ln2·e split keeping total rounding error (two ≤half-ulp roundings near 11.09, i.e. <1e-6) within the 1e-6 absolute tolerance across the whole FP16 domain, including tiny/subnormal x handled via the correction term.
